```{r LC data exploration}
lcdir <- here('code', '22_Mediation', 'LC-processed-data')
## on JHPCE, this should be a symlink to /dcs05/lieber/marmaypag/LFF_spatialLC_LIBD4140/LFF_spatial_LC/processed-data
internal_ref_lc_pb <- file.path(lcdir, "shared_internal_ref", "DGEList_pseudobulkcounts_by_donor_forGP_unfilt_020426.RDS")
if (!file.exists(internal_ref_lc_pb)) {
    ## on JHPCE directly
    internal_ref_lc_pb <- file.path("/dcs05/lieber/marmaypag/LFF_spatialLC_LIBD4140/LFF_spatial_LC",
              "shared_internal_ref", "DGEList_pseudobulkcounts_by_donor_forGP_unfilt_020426.RDS")
    stopifnot(file.exists(internal_ref_lc_pb))
}
## LC astrocytes
flc <- file.path(lcdir, '12_DEanalyses_removedsampsAndFinalNMseg',"02b-voomLmFit_objs_and_DE_tables_LabSex_LabE2vE4_LabSingleGenos_LabAnces_LabAncesE4E2_noMixClusts_YRIcontAndCat_JUL2025.RDS")
lclst <- readRDS(flc)
## Bernie/Leo said:
## multi-layered list containing differential expression (DE) analysis inputs, intermediates, and
## result tables.The DGE tables you need are located within the object at:
## thisRds$cont_ances$E2E4label$detabs[c("LC_E4vE2","Astro_E4vE2")]
## these results control for genomic ancestry as a continuous measure

## For "Blue" design we look at the "Astro_E4vE2" table (DEGs from the LC astrocyte spatial domain)
detabs <- lclst$cont_ances$E2E4label$detabs
lca_dge <- detabs$Astro_E4vE2
lc_dge <- detabs$LC_E4vE2

cat("Total genes tested in Astro/LC domains:", nrow(lc_dge), "\n") # 7729

## LC "Astro" domain DEGs (FDR < 0.05) for the Blue design
lca_degs <- lca_dge[adj.P.Val < 0.05]
cat("LC Astro domain DEGs (FDR<0.05):", nrow(lca_degs), "\n\n")  # 191
## "LC" domain DEGS for the "Orange" design (FDR < 0.05, X->M Step2 testing)
lc_degs <- lc_dge[adj.P.Val < 0.05]
cat("LC domain DEGs (FDR<0.05):", nrow(lc_degs), "\n") # 182

if (!dir.exists(mdir)) dir.create(mdir, recursive = TRUE)
## save full DGE tables for later:
f_lc_dge <- file.path(mdir, "LC_E4vE2_DGEout_Bernie.rds")
saveRDS(lc_dge, f_lc_dge)
f_lc_astro_dge <- file.path(mdir, "LC_Astro_E4vE2_DGEout_Bernie.rds")
saveRDS(lca_dge, f_lc_astro_dge)

lcdgel <- lclst$cont_ances$E2E4label$dgel
samples_meta <- lcdgel$samples

meta_dt <- as.data.table(samples_meta)
## collapse by brnum: collect unique values for each column into a list
meta_collapsed <- meta_dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) list(unique(x))), by = brnum]
## filter columns where every element has length 1
consistent_cols <- sapply(meta_collapsed, function(col) all(lengths(col) == 1))
## subset to keep only those columns with unique values per brnum
meta_final <- meta_collapsed[, ..consistent_cols]
## unlist the columns to get back primitive types (instead of lists)
meta_final <- meta_final[, lapply(.SD, unlist)]
## identify columns where there is only 1 unique value across the entire dataset
single_val_cols <- sapply(meta_final, function(col) length(unique(col)) <= 1)
## remove these, no information
meta_final <- meta_final[, !..single_val_cols]
#     brnum   APOE Ancestry    Sex   Age   Rin         YRI geno_group APOlargeGrp
#    <char> <char>   <char> <char> <num> <num>       <num>     <char>      <char>
# 1: Br1039  E4hom       AA      F 51.45   8.6 0.702526009    F_E4hom          E4
# 2: Br5854  E2het       AA      M 68.38   9.0 0.587382094    M_E2het          E2
# 3: Br1691  E4hom       AA      F 46.53   8.5 0.796535558    F_E4hom          E4
# 4: Br2305  E4hom       AA      F 54.88   8.0 0.844023189    F_E4hom          E4
# 5: Br6263  E4het       AA      F 50.73   7.0 0.893353128    F_E4het          E4

# add APOE_syn to meta_final to match ERC metadata
meta_final[, APOE_syn := fifelse(APOE == "E2hom", "E2.E2",
                           fifelse(APOE == "E2het", "E2.E3",
                           fifelse(APOE == "E4het", "E3.E4",
                           fifelse(APOE == "E4hom", "E4.E4", NA_character_))))]
meta_final[, APOE_syn := factor(APOE_syn, levels = c("E2.E2", "E2.E3", "E3.E4", "E4.E4"))]
setnames(meta_final, "brnum", "BrNum")
setkey(meta_final, BrNum)
```

The LC dataset contains 5 spatial domains, each analyzed separately for APOE E4 vs E2 differential expression:
* Astro (77 samples, 30 donors) - LC astrocyte domain (blue design)
* LC (73 samples, 29 donors) - LC neuronal domain (orange design)
* ACHE_SERT_LC_WM (77 samples, 30 donors)
* ACHE_SERT_Npep (73 samples, 29 donors)
* Oligo_Astro (77 samples, 30 donors)

```{r better to just load Bernie's pseudobulked by donor data}
if (!dir.exists(mdir)) dir.create(mdir, recursive = TRUE)
f_astro_pbcounts <- file.path(mdir, 'lc_astro_pseudobulk_counts_by_donor.rds')
f_lc_pbcounts <- file.path(mdir, 'lc_lc_pseudobulk_counts_by_donor.rds')
if (file.exists(f_astro_pbcounts) && file.exists(f_lc_pbcounts)) {
    dgl_astro <- readRDS(f_astro_pbcounts)
    dgl_lc <- readRDS(f_lc_pbcounts)
} else {
  # read Bernie's DGEList with pseudobulk counts by donor:
  dgel_pb <- readRDS(internal_ref_lc_pb) ## DGEList
  #dim(dgel_pb$counts) # 29802 x 268
  ## only pull astro:
  dgl_astro <- dgel_pb[, grepl('^Astro_Br', colnames(dgel_pb))]
  #dim(dgl_astro$counts) # 29802 x 30 --> no gene expression filtering
  colnames(dgl_astro) <- sub('^Astro_', '', colnames(dgl_astro))
  ## now LC domain:
  dgl_lc <- dgel_pb[, grepl('^LC_Br', colnames(dgel_pb))]
  #dim(dgl_lc$counts) # 29802 x 29 --> grepl('^LC_', colnames(dgel_lc))
  ## no gene expression filtering
  colnames(dgl_lc) <- sub('^LC_', '', colnames(dgl_lc))
  ## drop all metadata except lib.size and group, bind and match by BrNum to rownames
  df <- cbind(dgl_lc$samples[, c("lib.size", "group"), drop = FALSE],
             as.data.frame(meta_final)[match(rownames(dgl_lc$samples), meta_final$BrNum), ])
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(df$BrNum)))
  dgl_lc$samples <- df
  ## do the same for astro:
  df <- cbind(dgl_astro$samples[, c("lib.size", "group"), drop = FALSE],
             as.data.frame(meta_final)[match(rownames(dgl_astro$samples), meta_final$BrNum), ])
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(df$BrNum)))
  dgl_astro$samples <- df
  ## if we are here, everything succeeded
  saveRDS(dgl_lc, f_lc_pbcounts)
  saveRDS(dgl_astro, f_astro_pbcounts)
}
```

```{r quick DGE with the donor-level pseudobulk counts}
## to check against Bernie's MODEL 2 in lc astro domain (lc_degs)

br_oc <- fread(file.path(mdir, "brnum_metadata_ERC_Oligo3_n30.tab"))
brovl <- intersect(br_oc$BrNum, dgl_astro$samples$BrNum)
dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dgl_astro[, brovl])

dge$samples$APOlargeGrp <- ifelse(dge$samples$APOE %in% c("E2hom","E2het"), "E2", "E4")
stopifnot(length(unique(dge$samples$APOlargeGrp)) == 2)
dge$samples$APOlargeGrp <- factor(dge$samples$APOlargeGrp)

#des <- model.matrix(~0 + APOlargeGrp + Sex + Age + YRI, data = dge$samples)
des <- model.matrix(~0 + APOE_syn + Sex + Age + YRI, data = dge$samples)
colnames(des) <- gsub("_syn", "_", colnames(des)) ## just to match mediation design matrix column names
keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge, design = des)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge)

## fit (no donor blocking; one sample per donor)
v.swt <- voomLmFit(dge, design = des, adaptive.span = TRUE, sample.weights = TRUE)
#trast <- makeContrasts(E4vE2 = APOlargeGrpE4 - APOlargeGrpE2, levels = des)
trast <- makeContrasts(
        carrier = "-0.5*(APOE_E2.E2 + APOE_E2.E3) + 0.5*(APOE_E3.E4 + APOE_E4.E4)",
        levels = des
    )
v.swt.fit <- contrasts.fit(v.swt, contrasts = trast)
v.swt.fit.e <- eBayes(v.swt.fit, robust = TRUE)

# topTable
tt <- topTable(v.swt.fit.e, coef = "carrier", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
ttsig <- subset(tt, adj.P.Val < 0.05)
summary(tt$adj.P.Val)
## 0 DEGs at FDR < 0.1
```

```{r Bernie's LC Astro APOE DGE model}
dgel <- readRDS(file.path(lcdir,"12_DEanalyses_removedsampsAndFinalNMseg",
                                "01a-DGElist_allClust_10spotmin_NOfilt.RDS"))
### to avoid any issues, replace "Br6119(re-dis)" with "Br6119" in the samples tables
dgel$samples$brnum[dgel$samples$brnum=="Br6119(re-dis)"] <- "Br6119"
### rather than adjust for lib.size, now we will drop the clusters making that necessary because they are of limited interest / mixed cell types: Vascular, Oligo_complex, Oligo, Astro_Oligo
newsamp <- dgel$samples
newsamp <- newsamp[!(newsamp$label %in% c("Vascular","Oligo_Complex","Oligo","Astro_Oligo")),]
newmat <- dgel$counts[,rownames(newsamp)]
newmat <- newmat[rowSums(newmat)>0,]
newg <- dgel$genes[rownames(newmat),]
## remove old dgelist
rm(dgel)
## make new dgelist from the subsetted data above
dgel <- DGEList(counts=newmat,samples=newsamp,genes=newg)
rm(newmat,newsamp,newg)
## edgeR's not going to like the decimals if the label names carried any, so remove them just in case
dgel$samples$label <-  gsub(x=dgel$samples$label,pattern="\\.",replacement="")
rownames(dgel$samples) <- gsub(x=rownames(dgel$samples),pattern="\\.",replacement="")
colnames(dgel$counts) <- gsub(x=colnames(dgel$counts),pattern="\\.",replacement="")
```

```{r Bernie MODEL 2 for LC astro DEGs E4 vs E2}
dgelE2E4 <- dgel
dgelE2E4$samples$APOlargeGrp <- ifelse(dgelE2E4$samples$APOE %in% c("E2hom", "E2het"), yes = "E2", no = "E4")
stopifnot(length(unique(dgelE2E4$samples$APOlargeGrp)) == 2)
dgelE2E4$samples$label_E2E4 <- paste0(dgelE2E4$samples$label, "_", dgelE2E4$samples$APOlargeGrp)
f_lc_dgel_flt <- file.path(lcdir, "LC_dgel_exprflt_normfactor_counts.qs2")
des <- model.matrix(~0 + label_E2E4 + Sex + Age + YRI, data = dgelE2E4$samples)
colnames(des) <- gsub(x = colnames(des), pattern = "label_E2E4", replacement = "")
# [1] "ACHE_SERT_LC_WM_E2" "ACHE_SERT_LC_WM_E4" "ACHE_SERT_Npep_E2"  "ACHE_SERT_Npep_E4"
# "Astro_E2"           "Astro_E4"           "LC_E2"              "LC_E4"              "Oligo_Astro_E2"
# [10] "Oligo_Astro_E4"     "SexM"               "Age"                "YRI"
# Filter using the design specified
## write filtered data with norm factors for later use
if (file.exists(f_lc_dgel_flt)) {
   dgelflt <- qs_read(f_lc_dgel_flt)
} else {
   dgelE2E4 <- edgeR::normLibSizes(dgelE2E4)
   keep <- filterByExpr.DGEList(dgelE2E4, design = des)
   dgelflt <- dgelE2E4[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
   dgelflt <- edgeR::normLibSizes(dgelflt)
   dgelflt$design <- des
   dgelflt$logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(dgelflt, log = TRUE)
   ## can I add the cleanedY matrix here for later use? (for logCPM and design, protecting )
   qs_save(dgelflt, f_lc_dgel_flt)
}


```



```{r Bernie's DGE voomLmFit across all labels}
# define contrasts to pass to makeContrasts (we have to do it this way due to
# environment weirdness with parallelization)
contrasts_list <- list()
for (current_label in unique(dgelflt$samples$label)) {
    contrast_name <- paste0(current_label, "_E4vE2")
    contrast_formula <- paste0(current_label, "_E4 - ", current_label, "_E2")

    new_contrast <- list(contrast_formula)
    names(new_contrast) <- contrast_name
    contrasts_list <- c(contrasts_list, new_contrast)
}
trastmat <- do.call(makeContrasts, c(contrasts_list, list(levels = des)))
## voom augmented with counts and logCPM for later use in plotting and cleaningY
fvoom <- file.path(lcdir, 'dgelE2E4_voomLmFit_object_MODEL2_with_counts.qs2')
if (!file.exists(fvoom)) {
   ## let's drop our previously stored design
   dgelflt$design <- NULL
   v.swt <- voomLmFit(dgelflt, design = des, block = as.factor(dgelflt$samples$brnum),
                   adaptive.span = TRUE, sample.weights = TRUE)
   ## add the counts and logCPM back to the voomLmFit object for later use
   v.swt$counts <- dgelflt$counts
   v.swt$logCPM <- dgelflt$logCPM
   v.swt$trasts <- trastmat
   qs_save(v.swt, fvoom)
} else {
   v.swt <- qs_read(fvoom)
}
## TODO: extract/prep/add cleanedY data for the Astro E4vE2 contrast for later use in plotting

v.swt.fit <- contrasts.fit(v.swt, contrasts = trastmat)
v.swt.fit.e <- eBayes(v.swt.fit, robust = TRUE)

## get only the Astro E4vE2 DEGs:
astro_dge <- topTable(v.swt.fit.e,  coef = "Astro_E4vE2",
                      number = Inf,  adjust.method = "BH")
## get top all tables
E2E4label_detabs <- lapply(colnames(v.swt.fit), FUN = function(t) {
    as.data.table(topTable(v.swt.fit.e, coef = t, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH"))
})
names(E2E4label_detabs) <- colnames(trastmat)
## to extract Astro E4vE2 DEGs:
astro_tt <- E2E4label_detabs[["Astro_E4vE2"]]
#keeplist <- list(voomLFt = v.swt, trastsFit = v.swt.fit, eBay = v.swt.fit.e,
#                 dgel = dgelE2E4, trasts = trastmat, detabs = E2E4label_detabs)
```

```{r LC NM DEGs - exploration and preparation for orange design}
## ============================================================================
## LC NM-related DEGs for the "Orange" Design (Design 1)
## ============================================================================
##
## The orange design tests whether LC neuromelanin (NM)-linked biology mediates
## the APOE effect on ERC Oligo.3 gene expression.
##
## There are TWO distinct NM-related DEG sources, each from a different analysis:
##
## --- Source 1: NM+/NM- binary DEGs (04- file) ---
## File: 04-LCNMpos_vs_LCNMneg_DE.txt
## Code: 04-LCNMpos_vsNMneg_DE.Rmd (in LFF_spatial_LC repo)
## Model: limma/voom DGE on pseudobulked counts (per donor x NM-status section)
##   gene_expr ~ NM_status(+/-) + Sex + APOE + Age + YRI  [blocked by donor]
##   Contrast: LC_NMpos - LC_NMneg
## Tests: which genes are differentially expressed between NM+ and NM- spots
## logFC > 0 => higher in NM+ spots; logFC < 0 => higher in NM- spots
## These are standard limma topTable results (columns: gene_id, logFC, adj.P.Val, etc.)
##
## --- Source 2: NM-metric LMM DEGs (11- file) ---
## File: 11-LCNMspots_NMmetric_LMMed_by_geneLogcounts_3apoeFactorizations.RDS
## Code: 11-LMM_spotlogcounts_to_NMmetrics_gene_as_covar.Rmd (in LFF_spatial_LC repo)
## Model: for each gene g, at individual spot level on LC NM+ spots only:
##   NM_metric ~ gene_expr(g) + Age + Sex + YRI + APOE + (1|donor) + (1|donor:capture) + (1|donor:capture:sample)
## Test: LRT - does adding gene_expr improve model fit for predicting NM metric?
## Two NM metrics: Intensity_NM (pixel intensity, continuous) and Prop_NM (proportion, continuous)
## Three APOE factorizations: E4carrierYN (binary), E4copiesOrderedFact, PerGeno
## We use E4carrierYN (binary carrier) to align with our mediation X variable.
## Directionality: negative coefficient => higher expression associated with darker/stronger NM
##
## NOTE: These are NOT "APOE DEGs" — they are "NM-associated genes". The NM LMM
## identifies genes whose expression predicts NM state, controlling for APOE.
## The LC domain E4vE2 DEGs (182 genes) are a separate analysis (already used in blue design).
##
## For mediation, M = donor-level expression from dgl_lc (LC domain pseudobulk by donor,
## 29802 genes x 29 donors), using log-CPM.
## ============================================================================

## --- Load Source 2: NM-metric LMM results (11- file) ---
## Nested list structure:
##   lcnm$E4carrierYN$Intensity_NM  (142,464 rows x 11 cols = 23,744 genes x 6 rows each)
##   lcnm$E4carrierYN$Prop_NM       (142,464 rows x 9 cols  = 23,743 genes x 6 rows each)
##   lcnm$E4copiesOrderedFact$...   (not used here)
##   lcnm$PerGeno$...               (not used here)
## Per gene, 6 rows: Age, E4carrier, Sex, YRI, gene_itself, LRTvs_no_gene_coef
## Gene-level result: where gene_name == variable (the gene's own coefficient row)
## FDR columns: fdr_gene, bonf_gene (present in Intensity_NM; absent in Prop_NM — must compute)

flcnm <- file.path(lcdir, '11-LCNMspots_NMmetric_LMMed_by_geneLogcounts_3apoeFactorizations.RDS')
lcnm <- readRDS(flcnm)

## Extract gene-level rows for Intensity_NM (E4carrierYN factorization)
nmde_int <- lcnm$E4carrierYN$Intensity_NM[gene_name == variable]
cat("NM Intensity: genes tested =", nrow(nmde_int),
    ", FDR<0.05 =", nrow(nmde_int[fdr_gene < 0.05]),
    ", Bonf<0.05 =", nrow(nmde_int[bonf_gene < 0.05]), "\n")

## Extract gene-level rows for Prop_NM (compute FDR since it's missing)
nmde_prop <- lcnm$E4carrierYN$Prop_NM[gene_name == variable]
nmde_prop[, fdr_gene := p.adjust(p, method = "BH")]
cat("NM Proportion: genes tested =", nrow(nmde_prop),
    ", FDR<0.05 =", sum(nmde_prop$fdr_gene < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

## --- Load Source 1: NM+/NM- binary DEGs (04- file) ---
f04 <- file.path(lcdir, "04-LCNMpos_vs_LCNMneg_DE.txt")
nm_posneg <- fread(f04)
## This is a standard limma topTable with columns: gene_id, gene_name, logFC, adj.P.Val, etc.
cat("NM+/NM- binary: genes tested =", nrow(nm_posneg),
    ", FDR<0.05 =", sum(nm_posneg$adj.P.Val < 0.05),
    " (up in NM+ =", sum(nm_posneg$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & nm_posneg$logFC > 0),
    ", down =", sum(nm_posneg$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & nm_posneg$logFC < 0), ")\n\n")

## --- Overlap summary ---
int_sig_names <- nmde_int[fdr_gene < 0.05]$gene_name
prop_sig_names <- nmde_prop[fdr_gene < 0.05]$gene_name
binary_sig_names <- nm_posneg[adj.P.Val < 0.05]$gene_name
nm_cont_union <- union(int_sig_names, prop_sig_names)

cat("Overlap: Intensity ∩ Proportion =", length(intersect(int_sig_names, prop_sig_names)), "\n")
cat("Union Intensity ∪ Proportion =", length(nm_cont_union), "\n")
cat("NM+/NM- binary ∩ NM continuous union =", length(intersect(binary_sig_names, nm_cont_union)), "\n")
cat("NM Intensity ∩ LC E4vE2 DEGs =", length(intersect(int_sig_names, lc_degs$gene_name)), "\n")
cat("NM+/NM- binary ∩ LC E4vE2 DEGs =", length(intersect(binary_sig_names, lc_degs$gene_name)), "\n\n")
```

```{r LC NM - prepare mediation data objects}
## ============================================================================
## Prepare data for two orange-design mediation options:
##   lc_nm      -> NM+/NM- binary DEGs (Source 1, 04- file)
##   lc_nm_int  -> NM Intensity LMM DEGs (Source 2, 11- file, E4carrierYN)
##
## Both use the same donor-level expression source: dgl_lc (LC domain pseudobulk,
## 29802 genes x 29 donors). Rownames are Ensembl IDs; gene symbols in $genes$gene_name.
## The mediation script needs:
##   med_degs: data.table with columns cluster, gene_id, gene_name, med_gene_id
##   med_expr: matrix of log-CPM values (med_gene_id x BrNum)
## ============================================================================

## --- Gene symbol -> Ensembl ID mapping from LC pseudobulk ---
## The 04- file has gene_id (Ensembl) directly.
## The 11- LMM results have only gene_name (symbols); must map via dgl_lc$genes.
gene_map_lc <- as.data.table(dgl_lc$genes[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")])
## 9 gene_names map to 2 Ensembl IDs; deduplicate (keep first)
gene_map_lc <- gene_map_lc[!duplicated(gene_name)]
setkey(gene_map_lc, gene_name)

## --- Option 1: lc_nm (NM+/NM- binary DEGs) ---
## 04- file already has gene_id; just select significant and add cluster label
nm_sign_degs <- nm_posneg[adj.P.Val < 0.05, .(gene_id, gene_name, logFC, adj.P.Val)]
nm_sign_degs[, cluster := "LCNM"]
nm_sign_degs[, med_gene_id := paste0("LCNM|", gene_id)]
## Verify these gene_ids exist in dgl_lc
nm_sign_degs[, in_pb := gene_id %in% rownames(dgl_lc$counts)]
cat("lc_nm: NM+/NM- binary DEGs =", nrow(nm_sign_degs),
    ", in LC pseudobulk =", sum(nm_sign_degs$in_pb), "\n")
## Keep only those present in pseudobulk
nm_sign_degs <- nm_sign_degs[in_pb == TRUE][, in_pb := NULL]
setorder(nm_sign_degs, gene_id)

## --- Option 2: lc_nm_int (NM Intensity LMM DEGs) ---
## 11- file has gene_name only; map to Ensembl via gene_map_lc
nm_int_degs <- nmde_int[fdr_gene < 0.05, .(gene_name, coef, fdr_gene)]
nm_int_degs <- merge(nm_int_degs, gene_map_lc, by = "gene_name", all.x = FALSE)
nm_int_degs[, cluster := "LCNMint"]
nm_int_degs[, med_gene_id := paste0("LCNMint|", gene_id)]
## Verify these gene_ids exist in dgl_lc
nm_int_degs[, in_pb := gene_id %in% rownames(dgl_lc$counts)]
cat("lc_nm_int: NM Intensity LMM DEGs =", nrow(nm_int_degs),
    ", in LC pseudobulk =", sum(nm_int_degs$in_pb), "\n")
nm_int_degs <- nm_int_degs[in_pb == TRUE][, in_pb := NULL]
setorder(nm_int_degs, gene_id)

## --- Build expression matrices (log-CPM from LC pseudobulk by donor) ---
## Normalize and compute log-CPM
dgl_lc_norm <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dgl_lc)
lc_logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(dgl_lc_norm, log = TRUE)
## lc_logcpm: 29802 genes (Ensembl IDs) x 29 donors

## Expression matrix for lc_nm (NM+/NM- binary)
nm_sign_expr <- lc_logcpm[nm_sign_degs$gene_id, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(nm_sign_expr) <- nm_sign_degs$med_gene_id
cat("\nlc_nm expression matrix:", nrow(nm_sign_expr), "genes x", ncol(nm_sign_expr), "donors\n")

## Expression matrix for lc_nm_int (NM Intensity)
nm_int_expr <- lc_logcpm[nm_int_degs$gene_id, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(nm_int_expr) <- nm_int_degs$med_gene_id
cat("lc_nm_int expression matrix:", nrow(nm_int_expr), "genes x", ncol(nm_int_expr), "donors\n")

## --- Save prepared objects for 01_mediation_screening.R ---
## DEG tables
f_nm_sign_degs <- file.path(mdir, "LC_NMposneg_DEGs_for_mediation.rds")
saveRDS(nm_sign_degs, f_nm_sign_degs)
f_nm_int_degs <- file.path(mdir, "LC_NMintensity_DEGs_for_mediation.rds")
saveRDS(nm_int_degs, f_nm_int_degs)
## Expression matrices (log-CPM)
f_nm_sign_expr <- file.path(mdir, "LC_NMposneg_logcpm_for_mediation.rds")
saveRDS(nm_sign_expr, f_nm_sign_expr)
f_nm_int_expr <- file.path(mdir, "LC_NMintensity_logcpm_for_mediation.rds")
saveRDS(nm_int_expr, f_nm_int_expr)
## Also save the LC pseudobulk counts DGEList (for the mediation script to filter/normalize)
f_lc_pb <- file.path(mdir, "lc_lc_pseudobulk_counts_by_donor.rds")
if (!file.exists(f_lc_pb)) saveRDS(dgl_lc, f_lc_pb)

cat("\nSaved to", mdir, ":\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_nm_sign_degs), " (", nrow(nm_sign_degs), " DEGs)\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_nm_int_degs), " (", nrow(nm_int_degs), " DEGs)\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_nm_sign_expr), "\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_nm_int_expr), "\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_lc_pb), "(already existed:", file.exists(f_lc_pb), ")\n")
```

```{r Step 2 validation - donor-level APOE DGE for NM mediator genes}
## ============================================================================
## Baron & Kenny Step 2: Does APOE (X) significantly affect the mediator (M)?
##
## NM-linked genes are NOT necessarily APOE DEGs — they were identified by
## association with NM biology. Step 2 asks whether APOE also drives these genes.
## We run a fresh donor-level DGE on the LC domain pseudobulk (dgl_lc, 29 donors)
## using the same 4-level APOE model and weighted carrier contrast as the ERC outcome.
##
## This cell produces annotated DEG tables with an `apoe_fdr` column, and also
## a pre-computed donor-level DGE table restricted to the 21 overlap donors for
## use in panel D of the mediation plots.
##
## Data hierarchy for the orange design plots:
##   Panel C (mediator source context): section-level LC domain (73 sections, 29 donors)
##     -> from v.swt / dgelflt / lcdgel  (already computed in earlier cells)
##   Panel D (donor-level recalc): 21 overlap donors, donor-level pseudobulk
##     -> computed here
## ============================================================================

## --- 1. Full 29-donor DGE (B&K Step 2 proper) ---
## Use dgl_lc (29802 genes x 29 donors, LC domain pseudobulk by donor)
dge29 <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dgl_lc)
des29 <- model.matrix(~0 + APOE_syn + Sex + Age + YRI, data = dge29$samples)
colnames(des29) <- gsub("_syn", "_", colnames(des29))

keep29 <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge29, design = des29)
dge29 <- dge29[keep29, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge29 <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge29)
cat("29-donor DGE: genes after filterByExpr =", nrow(dge29), "\n")

v29 <- voomLmFit(dge29, design = des29, adaptive.span = TRUE, sample.weights = TRUE)
trast29 <- makeContrasts(
    carrier = "-0.5*(APOE_E2.E2 + APOE_E2.E3) + 0.5*(APOE_E3.E4 + APOE_E4.E4)",
    levels = des29
)
v29.fit <- contrasts.fit(v29, contrasts = trast29)
v29.fit.e <- eBayes(v29.fit, robust = TRUE)

tt29 <- as.data.table(topTable(v29.fit.e, coef = "carrier", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH"))
cat("29-donor DGE: FDR<0.05 =", sum(tt29$adj.P.Val < 0.05),
    ", FDR<0.10 =", sum(tt29$adj.P.Val < 0.10),
    ", nominal p<0.05 =", sum(tt29$P.Value < 0.05), "\n\n")

## --- 2. Annotate NM DEG tables with APOE FDR from 29-donor DGE ---
## For NM+/NM- binary DEGs
nm_sign_degs_step2 <- copy(nm_sign_degs)
nm_sign_degs_step2 <- merge(nm_sign_degs_step2,
    tt29[, .(gene_id, apoe_logFC = logFC, apoe_pval = P.Value, apoe_fdr = adj.P.Val)],
    by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
n_tested <- sum(!is.na(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_fdr))
n_pass_fdr05 <- sum(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pass_fdr10 <- sum(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_fdr < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pass_nom05 <- sum(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_pval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("NM+/NM- binary DEGs (", nrow(nm_sign_degs_step2), "):\n")
cat("  In 29-donor DGE:", n_tested, "\n")
cat("  Step 2 pass (APOE FDR<0.05):", n_pass_fdr05, "\n")
cat("  Step 2 pass (APOE FDR<0.10):", n_pass_fdr10, "\n")
cat("  Step 2 pass (APOE nom p<0.05):", n_pass_nom05, "\n\n")

## For NM Intensity LMM DEGs
nm_int_degs_step2 <- copy(nm_int_degs)
nm_int_degs_step2 <- merge(nm_int_degs_step2,
    tt29[, .(gene_id, apoe_logFC = logFC, apoe_pval = P.Value, apoe_fdr = adj.P.Val)],
    by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
n_tested_i <- sum(!is.na(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_fdr))
n_pass_fdr05_i <- sum(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pass_fdr10_i <- sum(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_fdr < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pass_nom05_i <- sum(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_pval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("NM Intensity LMM DEGs (", nrow(nm_int_degs_step2), "):\n")
cat("  In 29-donor DGE:", n_tested_i, "\n")
cat("  Step 2 pass (APOE FDR<0.05):", n_pass_fdr05_i, "\n")
cat("  Step 2 pass (APOE FDR<0.10):", n_pass_fdr10_i, "\n")
cat("  Step 2 pass (APOE nom p<0.05):", n_pass_nom05_i, "\n\n")

## --- 3. Panel D data: 21-overlap donor DGE ---
## This is needed by plotMedComp() panel D to show donor-level APOE effect
## restricted to the donors shared between LC and ERC.
ovl_donors <- brovl  ## 21 overlap donors (LC ∩ ERC), computed in earlier cell
stopifnot(length(ovl_donors) == 21)
## Subset dgl_lc to overlap donors
dge21 <- dgl_lc[, ovl_donors]
dge21 <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge21)
des21 <- model.matrix(~0 + APOE_syn + Sex + Age + YRI, data = dge21$samples)
colnames(des21) <- gsub("_syn", "_", colnames(des21))

keep21 <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge21, design = des21)
dge21 <- dge21[keep21, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge21 <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge21)
cat("21-overlap DGE: genes after filterByExpr =", nrow(dge21), "\n")

v21 <- voomLmFit(dge21, design = des21, adaptive.span = TRUE, sample.weights = TRUE)
trast21 <- makeContrasts(
    carrier = "-0.5*(APOE_E2.E2 + APOE_E2.E3) + 0.5*(APOE_E3.E4 + APOE_E4.E4)",
    levels = des21
)
v21.fit <- contrasts.fit(v21, contrasts = trast21)
v21.fit.e <- eBayes(v21.fit, robust = TRUE)

tt21 <- as.data.table(topTable(v21.fit.e, coef = "carrier", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH"))
cat("21-overlap DGE: FDR<0.05 =", sum(tt21$adj.P.Val < 0.05),
    ", FDR<0.10 =", sum(tt21$adj.P.Val < 0.10),
    ", nominal p<0.05 =", sum(tt21$P.Value < 0.05), "\n\n")

## Annotate overlap-donor results onto NM DEG tables
nm_sign_degs_step2 <- merge(nm_sign_degs_step2,
    tt21[, .(gene_id, apoe_logFC_21 = logFC, apoe_pval_21 = P.Value, apoe_fdr_21 = adj.P.Val)],
    by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
nm_int_degs_step2 <- merge(nm_int_degs_step2,
    tt21[, .(gene_id, apoe_logFC_21 = logFC, apoe_pval_21 = P.Value, apoe_fdr_21 = adj.P.Val)],
    by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)

cat("--- Step 2 summary (21-overlap donors) ---\n")
cat("NM+/NM- binary: tested =", sum(!is.na(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_fdr_21)),
    ", FDR<0.05 =", sum(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_fdr_21 < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    ", nom p<0.05 =", sum(nm_sign_degs_step2$apoe_pval_21 < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("NM Intensity:   tested =", sum(!is.na(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_fdr_21)),
    ", FDR<0.05 =", sum(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_fdr_21 < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    ", nom p<0.05 =", sum(nm_int_degs_step2$apoe_pval_21 < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

## --- 4. Save annotated tables and panel D topTable ---
f_nm_sign_step2 <- file.path(mdir, "LC_NMposneg_DEGs_step2_annotated.rds")
saveRDS(nm_sign_degs_step2, f_nm_sign_step2)
f_nm_int_step2 <- file.path(mdir, "LC_NMintensity_DEGs_step2_annotated.rds")
saveRDS(nm_int_degs_step2, f_nm_int_step2)

## Panel D topTable (21-overlap donors, full gene set)
f_tt21_lc <- file.path(mdir, "LC_donor21_APOE_carrier_topTable.rds")
saveRDS(tt21, f_tt21_lc)
## Also save the voom object for panel D (logCPM + targets for cleaningY)
f_v21_lc <- file.path(mdir, "LC_donor21_voomLmFit.rds")
saveRDS(v21, f_v21_lc)

cat("Saved Step 2 annotated DEG tables and panel D data to:\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_nm_sign_step2), "\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_nm_int_step2), "\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_tt21_lc), "(topTable, all", nrow(tt21), "genes)\n")
cat("  ", basename(f_v21_lc), "(voomLmFit object for cleaningY)\n")
### 0 genes pass FDR<0.05 when performing DGE on donor-pseudobulked data
```
